instructionsTitle.message: From a page issue to an actionable change plan

instructionsLead.message: Capture runtime evidence, check the target, then hand the full context to Codex, Claude, or Cursor in the current project.

instructionsCalloutTitle.message: Start capture before you reproduce the issue

instructionsCalloutDetail.message: Console and network evidence only cover the window after you start capture.

instructionsStep1Detail.message: Click Start annotating or Record page.

instructionsStep2Detail.message: Trigger the issue again on the page so the related logs and requests happen inside the capture window.

instructionsStep3Detail.message: Use the toolbar at the lower right to click key elements and fill in actual behavior and the expected result. Press Escape to exit.

instructionsStep4Detail.message: After saving, keep selecting. You can also click a number to edit it, or use undo and clear.

instructionsStep5Detail.message: Files go to the Rootline folder in Chrome downloads by default. You can switch the popup to Remote and configure Tencent COS or Alibaba Cloud OSS in a separate window.

instructionsStep6Detail.message: Local mode copies the local path. Remote mode copies the object-storage report link that was already created, without uploading again.

instructionsEvidencePageDetail.message: URL, title, viewport, DPR, browser, and language.

instructionsEvidenceTargetsDetail.message: DOM summary, key styles, CSS rules, selector, and React hints.

instructionsEvidenceConsoleDetail.message: Logs, page errors, and unhandled Promise rejections after capture starts.

instructionsEvidenceNetworkDetail.message: fetch, XHR, resource status, duration, and redacted body previews.

instructionsEvidenceVideoDetail.message: 1280 × 720 silent WebM, plus up to 24 keyframe timestamps.

instructionsPrivacyTitle.message: Local / remote storage and capture boundaries

instructionsRedactionDetail.message: Sensitive headers, query values, JSON, and form fields are hidden, and content is truncated at fixed limits.

instructionsSaveModesDetail.message: Local mode writes to Downloads/Rootline. Remote mode writes directly to your own Tencent COS or Alibaba Cloud OSS. Prefer public-read, private-write, and do not use public read-write. Turn off forced download, or the browser will download report.html. CORS should expose Content-Disposition, Content-Type, Content-Length, and ETag.

instructionsNotCollectedDetail.message: Cookies, LocalStorage, SessionStorage, passwords, full page HTML, and browsing history do not enter the report.

instructionsOutputDetail.message: report.md, report.json, and capture.png. Recording captures also include capture.webm.

instructionsTip1.message: Describe the symptom and the correct behavior before copying context. Do not assume a root cause.

instructionsTip2.message: For API issues, trigger the request again after capture starts.

instructionsTip3.message: Recordings contain no audio and stop automatically at the internal duration limit.

instructionsTip4.message: Chrome internal pages, the store, PDFs, cross-origin iframes, and closed shadow roots are limited by browser permissions.

instructionsFooter.message: Rootline does not call a model and does not upload data to a Rootline server. Remote mode only writes to your own object storage.

settingsIntro.message: Rootline uploads the report, screenshot, and recording directly to your own object storage. It does not pass through a Rootline server.

settingsPermissionDetail.message: Do not choose public read-write. Public read lets an AI open the report. Private write stops strangers from uploading, overwriting, or deleting files.

settingsPrivacy.message: Rootline does not provide a cloud service and does not store or receive your reports, screenshots, recordings, or page content. Files upload only to the object storage you configure. Credentials stay in this browser extension and are not written into the report.

settingsTencentSummary.message: Tencent Cloud guide: create a sub-user, grant access, and create keys

settingsTencentNote.message: Prefer a CAM sub-user limited to the Rootline object prefix. An existing key also works. You do not need a sub-account ID.

settingsTencentStep1.message: Open the Tencent COS console, create a bucket, and record the full Bucket and Region. Set access to public read, private write.

settingsTencentStep2.message: In the bucket domain or object metadata, turn off forced download and set Content-Disposition to inline.

settingsTencentStep3.message: In CAM user management, create a sub-user and grant PutObject, GetObject, HeadObject, and DeleteObject on rootline/*.

settingsTencentStep4.message: Create a SecretId and SecretKey on the sub-user API key page, or open API key management. Do not grant only QcloudCollApiKeyManageAccess.

settingsTencentStep5.message: Under Security → CORS, allow PUT, GET, HEAD, DELETE, and OPTIONS, and expose Content-Disposition, Content-Type, Content-Length, and ETag.

settingsTencentStep6.message: Set a 7-day or 30-day lifecycle so old captures are cleaned up automatically.

settingsTencentWarning.message: If the test returns 403, check that the Bucket includes the owner APPID suffix, plus object permissions and CORS.

settingsAliyunSummary.message: Alibaba Cloud OSS guide: create a RAM user, grant access, and create keys

settingsAliyunNote.message: Prefer a RAM user limited to the Rootline object prefix. Rootline connects from the browser with an AccessKey and does not need a Rootline service.

settingsAliyunStep1.message: Open the Alibaba Cloud OSS console, create a bucket, and record the Bucket and Region. Set read/write access to public read, private write.

settingsAliyunStep2.message: In the bucket domain or object metadata, turn off forced download and set Content-Disposition to inline.

settingsAliyunStep3.message: Open RAM user management, create a user, and follow the Bucket Policy docs to grant PutObject, GetObject, HeadObject, and DeleteObject on the bucket’s rootline/* prefix.

settingsAliyunStep4.message: Under the RAM user’s Authentication → AccessKey, create an AccessKey ID and Secret, or open AccessKey management. Do not use the Alibaba Cloud account root key.

settingsAliyunStep5.message: Under OSS Data Security → CORS, allow PUT, GET, HEAD, DELETE, and OPTIONS, expose Content-Disposition, Content-Type, Content-Length, and ETag, and see the OSS CORS docs.

settingsAliyunStep6.message: Set a 7-day or 30-day lifecycle so old captures are cleaned up. Do not paste the AccessKey into reports, tickets, or chat.

settingsAliyunWarning.message: If the test returns 403, check RAM object permissions, bucket access, Region, and CORS. Public read lets an AI read the report. Do not enable public read-write.
